Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Anil - 28 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Hema - 26 years, daughter
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Shalini - 65 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
4. Rajesh - 61 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights
2. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The main road - Day

[Anil stands on the road. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "Anil, what's the plan today?"

[Anil starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Shalini: "Yes, all right."

[Anil is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Shalini: "That's great!"

[Anil steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Anil (laughing): "Okay, Mom."

[A dog runs in front of Anil's car; he brakes hard and swerves just in time.]

Anil (gently): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 2: The kitchen - Day

[Hema stands in the kitchen. Shalini and Rajesh stand near her.]

Hema: "Dad, look over here."

[Hema rolls out rotis on the board.]

Shalini (surprised): "Really?"

[Hema stirs the dal in the pot.]

Shalini: "Let's see."

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Anil stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Anil: "What a nice place."

[Anil drinks a beer.]

Anil: "That's easy."

[Anil staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Shalini: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Anil and Mother clink their glasses.]

Anil (surprised): "I'm ready!"

[Anil walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Anil: "That was such a fun day!"
